noun_definition: ios refers to the mobile operating system developed by Apple that is being used to access the invite message link in the described issue.
ws invite refers to a link sent by a user that is intended to direct recipients to a specific invite message page within a workspace conversation.
Invite message link refers to a hyperlink that, when tapped, is expected to direct the user to the invite message page within a conversation in the application.
Invite message page refers to the specific screen that should be displayed when a user taps on the invite message link in a conversation after sending it.
